spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands with extensive white cumulus and layered clouds covering the northern and eastern areas. The Big Island is partially visible in the southeast under cloud with no distinct gray or brown haze streak separable from ordinary meteorological cloud. Southern and western ocean shows breaks with scattered clouds over dark water.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea remains paused following episode 55 on October 17. The forecast for episode 56 fountaining has been pushed to Nov. 1-7, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
